text: Good photo app primarily for storing all your photos in the cloud. If you're looking for a "gallery" type of app for your phone or SD card only, there are simpler apps. If you're looking for a robust app that automatically backs up your photos for you, has facial recognition (even with pets and inanimate objects easy to find via search), assistant features for auto creating videos based on photos and videos you upload, and so many other awesome features, then this is the app to use.
